Feature: Alarms
  As a user
  I want the system to report alarms for proximal tube disconnection and obstruction
  So that I can take corrective action

  Scenario: Proximal tube connected
    Given the proximal tube is connected
    When the system checks the tube connection
    Then the system reports "Proximal tube connected"

  Scenario: Proximal tube disconnected
    Given the proximal tube is disconnected
    When the system checks the tube connection
    Then the system reports "Proximal tube disconnected" with medium priority

  Scenario: Obstruction detected
    Given the VTI is less than 100ml
    When the system checks for obstruction
    Then the system reports "Obstruction" with high priority

  Scenario: Obstruction not detected
    Given the VTI is 100ml or more
    When the system checks for obstruction
    Then the system reports "No obstruction"

  Scenario: Proximal tube disconnected and obstruction detected
    Given the proximal tube is disconnected and the VTI is less than 100ml
    When the system checks the tube connection and obstruction
    Then the system reports "Proximal tube disconnected" with medium priority and "Obstruction" with high priority

  Scenario Outline: Proximal tube connection and obstruction detection with varying VTI values
    Given the proximal tube is connected/disconnected and the VTI is <VTI>
    When the system checks the tube connection and obstruction
    Then the system reports "Proximal tube connected/disconnected" with medium priority and "No obstruction/Obstruction" with high priority

    Examples:
      | VTI | Proximal Tube Connected | Obstruction Detected |
      | 0   | false                   | true                 |
      | 100 | true                    | false                |
      | 99  | true                    | true                 |
      | 101 | false                   | false                |
